description:
Returns the domains the account sends its emails from, each with the DNS records to publish
and the verification status of the domain and of every record. It only reads; it does not
register or verify anything.

- **Without the add-on:** the list is still returned, so you can see what the account
  holds, and `max_email_domains` is `0`.
- **`max_email_domains`:** the maximum number of domains the custom email domain add-on allows the
  account; `null` when the add-on sets no explicit limit. The add-on is contracted with
  BeeL.
- **`verified_at` and `last_checked_at`:** absent until the domain is verified or checked
  for the first time.
- **Environment:** domains belong to the account and are the same in test and live.

**Closed catalogue.** The domains of an account are a short, bounded set: the response
carries no `pagination`, the operation takes no paging parameters, and every response holds the
whole set.

BeeL API endpoint: GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/email-domains (reference: https://docs.beel.es)

account_id.description: Your own account, or an account you provisioned. The account in the path, not the credential, decides which account the operation acts on. A `403` is returned when you do not reach it, the same response an account that does not exist gets.

name: beel_list_email_domains
